normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Elevator- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day**- 9 adult bikes- Beginning March 1, 2024, a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle is included- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 4 beach chairs with 2 umbrellas (Mar 1-Oct 31)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Elysee Court is a beacon of coastal luxury nestled in the family-friendly Seacrest Beach community, offering Gulf-front splendor. With 5,500 square feet of living space—plus a rooftop deck—this gorgeous home hosts up to 16 guests in 5 bedrooms with 5 bathrooms, perfect for large groups or families. Indulge in relaxation with a refreshing dip in the private pool or enjoy a quick stroll along the boardwalk to the nearest beach access with complimentary beach services seasonally.Upon entering the main floor of this elegant 4-story home, guests are greeted by a bright and airy great room boasting creamy white décor with baby blue accents. Unwind in a second-floor living area with plush seating and gorgeous picture windows that let in natural light. The traditional dining area seats 10, making it ideal for entertaining—especially with direct access to the second-floor patio’s grill and private pool. A well-equipped kitchen boasts stunning marble countertops and mid-century modern cabinets that camouflage the refrigerator. Off the kitchen is an additional entertainment space featuring a round dining table and a wet bar with a serving window accessible from the patio. An adjoining sitting area with a TV and sectional couch provides an extra gathering space, while the comfy guest bedroom with 2 cozy queen beds completes this floor.An in-home elevator and stairs lead to the third floor’s 2 guest bedrooms, including the primary bedroom, both with king beds and private bathrooms. Equipped with its own living space, an attached laundry room, and home office, the primary offers everything guests need to feel comfortable and productive.Take advantage of the wet bar for morning coffee or late-night cocktails on the fourth-floor landing. The sunroom includes a Peloton and a ping-pong table for guests’ entertainment. Outside, an expansive sundeck equipped with ample seating invites relaxation, while the top-floor viewing deck offers breathtaking Gulf vistas.Head downstairs to the first floor, where the remaining 2 bedrooms are located—1 guest bedroom with a king bed and 1 bunk room with 3 twin-over-twin beds. There’s also a laundry room for added convenience.Experience the ultimate seaside retreat at Elysee Court! With on-site parking for 5 vehicles—plus 9 adult bikes—it’s easy to explore nearby shops and restaurants along 30A. For beach access, use the shared boardwalk with Longue Vue Drive. Book this magnificent home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 16):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Three Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate*Please note: This property has access to a private neighborhood beach access. However, personal beach setups are not permitted at this beach.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seacrest Beach "Elysee Court" 85 Elysee Court Seacrest Beach, FL Bedrooms 5 Beds 11 Sleeps 16 Full Baths 5 Half Baths 2 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf views - Elevator - Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day** - 9 adult bikes - Beginning March 1, 2024, a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle is included - Complimentary beach setups each morning include 4 beach chairs with 2 umbrellas (Mar 1-Oct 31) - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Elysee Court is a beacon of coastal luxury nestled in the family-friendly Seacrest Beach community, offering Gulf-front splendor. With 5,500 square feet of living space—plus a rooftop deck—this gorgeous home hosts up to 16 guests in 5 bedrooms with 5 bathrooms, perfect for large groups or families. Indulge in relaxation with a refreshing dip in the private pool or enjoy a quick stroll along the boardwalk to the nearest beach access with complimentary beach services seasonally. Upon entering the main floor of this elegant 4-story home, guests are greeted by a bright and airy great room boasting creamy white décor with baby blue accents. Unwind in a second-floor living area with plush seating and gorgeous picture windows that let in natural light. The traditional dining area seats 10, making it ideal for entertaining—especially with direct access to the second-floor patio’s grill and private pool. A well-equipped kitchen boasts stunning marble countertops and mid-century modern cabinets that camouflage the refrigerator. Off the kitchen is an additional entertainment space featuring a round dining table and a wet bar with a serving window accessible from the patio. An adjoining sitting area with a TV and sectional couch provides an extra gathering space, while the comfy guest bedroom with 2 cozy queen beds completes this floor. An in-home elevator and stairs lead to the third floor’s 2 guest bedrooms, including the primary bedroom, both with king beds and private bathrooms. Equipped with its own living space, an attached laundry room, and home office, the primary offers everything guests need to feel comfortable and productive. Take advantage of the wet bar for morning coffee or late-night cocktails on the fourth-floor landing. The sunroom includes a Peloton and a ping-pong table for guests’ entertainment. Outside, an expansive sundeck equipped with ample seating invites relaxation, while the top-floor viewing deck offers breathtaking Gulf vistas. Head downstairs to the first floor, where the remaining 2 bedrooms are located—1 guest bedroom with a king bed and 1 bunk room with 3 twin-over-twin beds. There’s also a laundry room for added convenience. Experience the ultimate seaside retreat at Elysee Court! With on-site parking for 5 vehicles—plus 9 adult bikes—it’s easy to explore nearby shops and restaurants along 30A. For beach access, use the shared boardwalk with Longue Vue Drive. Book this magnificent home today!
